top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the drills were not documented.

top_violation_types.title: Operation and Program Director Annual Training-6 hours specific topics (26 TAC §744.1311(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The program director's training records were observed to be missing two hours in these specific topics.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §744.2507(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Observed mutiple cleaning supplies in the reach of the children to include Odoban, Ant spray,  and lysol. There was also multiple cans of spray paint and cans of paint on the floor.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Sterile Gauze Pads (26 TAC §744.2753(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's first aid kit is missing gauze.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
